name: Hawkins National Laboratory
description: A covert government facility run by Dr. Martin Brenner. It houses the Gate to the Upside Down and was used to develop Eleven's psychic abilities.

name: Byers House
description: The modest home of Joyce Byers and her sons Will and Jonathan. The Christmas-light communication board was strung across its living room wall.

name: Wheeler House
description: Home of the Wheeler family. Mike's basement serves as the Party's headquarters and Eleven's first refuge.

name: Hawkins Middle School
description: Where Mike, Will, Dustin, and Lucas attend school. The final showdown with the Demogorgon takes place here.

name: Mirkwood
description: A stretch of forest east of Hawkins where Will was last seen before vanishing. The Party uses it as a shortcut.

name: Castle Byers
description: Will's secret hideout in the woods behind his house — a fort made of scavenged wood and sheets. It exists as a pale shadow in the Upside Down.

name: Hawkins Police Department
description: Chief Hopper's base of operations. Small-town and underfunded, it becomes the nerve center for the search for Will.

name: Palace Arcade
description: The local arcade where the boys spend their free time. Dustin spots a mysterious high score left by a player named 'MADMAX' here in Season 2.

name: Sattler Quarry
description: A flooded quarry on the outskirts of Hawkins. A body — later revealed to be a decoy — is found here.

name: Hopper's Cabin
description: Chief Hopper's remote cabin in the woods. Later becomes Eleven's secret home after the events of Season 1.

name: The Gate
description: A tear in reality at the heart of Hawkins Lab, created when Eleven made contact with the Demogorgon. It is the source of all the Upside Down's intrusions.

name: Benny's Burgers
description: A diner run by Benny Hammond, who gives Eleven food after her escape from the lab — before agents from Hawkins Lab silence him.
